description: This file defines the ScriptEngine class, which is a Java implementation for executing scripts within the Apache OFBiz framework's service engine. It utilizes the javax.script API (JSR-223) to run scripts or script functions, managing script context and binding certain objects like parameters, dispatch context, dispatcher, and delegator. It provides methods for synchronous execution of scripts, handling results, and errors.

classes.name: ScriptEngine
classes.description: A final class extending GenericAsyncEngine, responsible for executing scripts in the OFBiz service engine context using JSR-223 scripting API. It manages script execution asynchronously and synchronously, creates script contexts, handles script invocation, and manages service-related objects within the script environment.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a script synchronously based on the given model service and context, managing script bindings, executing the script, and processing the result or exceptions.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Calls runSync but ignores its result, effectively running the script asynchronously without returning the output.
